# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately, not in a public issue or pull request.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: open the repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/fragments-sdk/ui/security) and choose **Report a vulnerability**,
or go straight to the [new advisory form](https://github.com/fragments-sdk/ui/security/advisories/new).
Only the maintainers can see the report.

Include:

- the affected version of `@usefragments/ui`, ideally checked against the latest release
- what an attacker can do, and under which conditions
- steps or a small example that reproduces it

The maintainers will reply in the advisory, work on a fix there, and publish the advisory with the
release that fixes it. Credit is given unless you ask otherwise.
